## Parameters
```{r}
lonLim <- c(-9.5, 4.3)
latLim <- c(36, 44)
years  <- 1984:2021
file_ba <- "/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/data/firespain_025_WGS84_v0.3.nc"
fire_season <- c(7, 8)
```


## Libraries
```{r, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(loadeR)
library(visualizeR)
library(transformeR)
source("load_data.R")
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Load fire data
```{r}
dat_ba <- loadGridData(file_ba, var = "ba", latLim = latLim, lonLim = lonLim, years = years)
```

## Fire map
```{r fire_map, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, dpi=300, fig.path="figures/"}
total_burned_area <- climatology(dat_ba, clim.fun = list(FUN = function(x) sum(x, na.rm = FALSE)))
spatialPlot(total_burned_area, main = "Total burned area (ha)", color.theme = "YlOrRd", backdrop.theme = "countries")
```

```{r fire_count_map, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, dpi=300, fig.path="figures/"}
fire_count <- climatology(dat_ba, clim.fun = list(FUN = function(x) sum(x > 50, na.rm = FALSE)))
spatialPlot(fire_count, main = "Number of fires > 50 ha", color.theme = "YlOrRd", backdrop.theme = "countries")
```

```{r fire_data_prep}
# Load data
dat_ba <- loadGridData(file_ba, var = "ba", latLim = latLim, lonLim = lonLim,
                       years = years, season = fire_season)

dat_fwi_era <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim,
                         what = "FWI", dataset = "ERA5Land", season = fire_season)

dat_fwi_cide <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim,
                          what = "FWI", dataset = "CIDE", season = fire_season)
```


```{r summarize_fire_fwi}
n_fire_50 = aggregateGrid(dat_ba, aggr.y = list(FUN = function(x) sum(x > 500,  na.rm = TRUE)))
n_fire_100 = aggregateGrid(dat_ba, aggr.y = list(FUN = function(x) sum(x > 100, na.rm = TRUE)))

p90_era = aggregateGrid(dat_fwi_era, aggr.y = list(FUN = "quantile", probs = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE))
p90_cide = aggregateGrid(dat_fwi_cide, aggr.y = list(FUN = "quantile", probs = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE))
```


```{r make_region_masks}
to_mat <- function(grid) matrix(grid$Data, nrow = dim(grid$Data)[1])

ba_mats  <- lapply(list(
  "n_fire_50" =  n_fire_50, 
  "n_fire_100" = n_fire_100
),  to_mat)
fwi_mats <- lapply(list(
  "p90_era" = p90_era, 
  "p90_cide" = p90_cide
), to_mat)
```


```{r cluster_regions}
K <- 3

kmeans_all <- readRDS("data/kmeans_results.rds")
kmeans_all <- kmeans_all[-1]
names(kmeans_all) <- paste0("k", 2:10)

ref_grid <- getGrid(dat_ba)

mask_orig <- as.vector(drop(kmeans_all[[paste0("k", K)]]$Data))
mask_rg   <- as.vector(drop(
  interpGrid(kmeans_all[[paste0("k", K)]], new.coordinates = ref_grid, method = "nearest")$Data
))

regions <- lapply(seq_len(K), function(r) {
  
  cells    <- which(mask_orig == r)
  cells_rg <- which(mask_rg   == r)
  
  list(
    # Fires
    n_fire_50  = rowSums(ba_mats$n_fire_50[,  cells_rg, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fire_100 = rowSums(ba_mats$n_fire_100[, cells_rg, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # FWI
    fwi_p90_era = apply(fwi_mats$p90_era[, cells, drop = FALSE], 1, max, na.rm = TRUE),
    fwi_p90_cide = apply(fwi_mats$p90_cide[, cells, drop = FALSE], 1, max, na.rm = TRUE))
})
```


```{r define_fwi_fire_plot}
plot_fwi_fire <- function(fwi, fire,
                          main = "FWI vs Fire relationship") {
  
  ok <- complete.cases(fwi, fire) & is.finite(fwi) & is.finite(fire)
  
  plot(fwi[ok], fire[ok],
       pch = 16,
       col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
       xlab = "FWI P90",
       ylab = "number of fires >50",
       main = main)
  
  # add regression line
  model <- lm(fire[ok] ~ fwi[ok])
  abline(model, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  
  r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
  legend("topleft", legend = paste0("r² = ", round(r2, 3)), bty = "n")

  print(summary(model))
}
```


```{r plot_regions_map, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, dpi=300, fig.path="figures/"}
lab <- c("E", "SW", "N")

print(spatialPlot(
  kmeans_all[[paste0("k", K)]],
  backdrop.theme = "countries",
  col.regions = brewer.pal(K, "Set2"),
  at = seq(0.5, K + 0.5, 1),
  colorkey = list(
    labels = list(
      at = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("E", "SW", "N")
    )
  )
))
```


```{r plot_region_scatter, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, dpi=300, fig.path="figures/"}
for (i in seq_along(regions)) {
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  
  plot_fwi_fire(
    regions[[i]]$fwi_p90_era,
    regions[[i]]$n_fire_50,
    main = paste0("Region ", lab[i], ": ERA5-Land")
  )
  
  plot_fwi_fire(
    regions[[i]]$fwi_p90_cide,
    regions[[i]]$n_fire_50,
    main = paste0("Region ", lab[i], ": CIDE")
  )
}
```
